case: Cedar allocation council — authored teaching cases
provenance: Synthetic parameters created for this chapter; no observed or forecast market data.
units: CU and one-period gross returns; each panel is a separate stated model.

conventions.liability: Four equally likely independent-sign states; fixed mean-variance preference over terminal CU surplus; long-only and a beginning cash reserve.
conventions.lifecycle: One-period terminal log utility; safe gross return one; nontradable endowment H0+h*(G-1); no borrowing or shorting.
conventions.dynamic: Two-period terminal utility -1/W; safe gross return one at every node; exogenous observed tree; long-only fractions in [0,1]; no flows or costs.
conventions.rebalancing: One risky asset and cash marked before trading; proportional fee on absolute risky CU traded, paid from cash immediately; target is a post-fee wealth fraction.
conventions.bands: One-period CU mean-variance preference, zero liability covariance, safe gross return one; cash-paid proportional fee, long-only and no borrowing.
conventions.uncertainty: Only the risky mean varies over a fixed closed interval; variance and risk coefficient are known model inputs; no confidence interpretation.
